26.1.2.26.1.2-22.0.0:
- **26.1.2 NeoForge Release**
- A couple QoL improvements
- Updated the wiki link and commands
- Updated Villager (Soul Exchanger) trades in this version
  - Added a couple variations to the Master (Level 5) trade outcomes
    - it can now generate minecraft and armorplus swords with random enchantments and soul stealer.
- **Known Issue**: Maces do not have textures
26.1.2.22.0.1: - Add geckolib support back - maces have textures and animations once again.
26.1.2.22.0.2:
- Remove "Water Weakness" from Infused Lava Armor.
- Add 8 more color variations to the stone bricks, and castle bricks.
- Make all castle block variations craftable, same recipe as colored stone bricks but with chiseled stone brick in center.
26.1.2.22.0.3: - Fixed Lava & Frost Crystal ores not generating.
26.1.2.22.0.4:
- Added an in-game Configuration screen (accessible from the Mods list).
- Ported the Auto-Smelting and item/block Availability (`hiddenItems`/`hiddenBlocks`) config options from the Forge version.
- Hidden Items/Hidden Blocks can now be picked from a searchable list of ArmorPlus items/blocks, grouped by category, in the Configuration screen.
- Fixed advanced material armor/weapon effect toggles (Guardian, Super Star, Ender Dragon, Slayer) incorrectly sharing a single on/off switch instead of having their own.
- Fixed a config section nesting bug that caused config options to end up misplaced.
- Added missing translations for all configuration entries.
26.1.2.22.0.5:
- Auto-Smelting recipes are now a single `smeltingRecipes` list of `block|result` entries (e.g. `minecraft:sand|minecraft:glass`), replacing the separate `smeltingInput`/`smeltingOutput` lists. Recipes can be added in the Configuration screen by picking the block(s) and then the result from any mod.
- Soul Harden's disallowed enchantments can be picked from a list of enchantments (while in a world).
- All config lists now have both an "Add from List..." picker and a manual add button, and can be emptied.
